query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.slug, p.name, p.description, p.status, p.owner_user_id,
                    p.created_at, p.updated_at
             FROM projects p
             WHERE (
                 p.owner_user_id = ?
                 OR EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm
                     WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = ?
                 )
             )
             AND (? IS NULL OR p.id > ?)
             ORDER BY p.id
             LIMIT ?
